audit: ATLAS unique quarterly Sentinel-1 RTC VV spatial-availability sample

measurement.validity_definition: Finite source pixels unequal to declared nodata; spatial availability only.

sampling.unit: platform × acquisition date × orbit state × absolute orbit; tiled items for one group are mosaicked
sampling.selection: Retain each unique group from three independent uniform-with-replacement draws. For duplicate or unavailable slots, deterministically sample uniformly without replacement from remaining eligible groups. This produces three unique groups per quarter.

areas.sample_rule: Three unique orbit groups per 2025 calendar quarter, selected under the fixed stratified random rule; duplicates in the prior three independent draws were replaced uniformly from remaining eligible groups.

interpretation_limits: This is a uniform quarterly sample of archive spatial availability, not event/baseline sampling adequacy.
Sentinel-1 RTC VV backscatter is not a water classification and does not validate OPERA DSWx-S1.
Nodata coverage alone does not assess speckle, layover/shadow, radiometric quality, acquisition-geometry balance, or classification accuracy.
A 2025 sample does not establish coverage for every event, date, asset, or the full 2024–2026 study window.
Independent event labels and confirmatory study-area enrollment remain unmet.
Planetary Computer SAS links are temporary and never included in outputs or checkpoints.
